description: DeploymentConfigRollbackSpec represents the options for rollback generation.

from.description: from points to a ReplicationController which is a deployment.

includeReplicationMeta.description: includeReplicationMeta specifies whether to include the replica count and selector.

includeStrategy.description: includeStrategy specifies whether to include the deployment Strategy.

includeTemplate.description: includeTemplate specifies whether to include the PodTemplateSpec.

includeTriggers.description: includeTriggers specifies whether to include config Triggers.

revision.description: revision to rollback to. If set to 0, rollback to the last revision.
